description: pkix-revocation/src/../deviation.rs:599: DeviationStore::find_deviation iterates all deviations on every call. DeviationRunner::run_cert calls this once per finding per cert. For a chain of 3 certs × 6 lints × 100 deviations in the store = 1800 linear scans per chain validation. With a lint runner producing many findings, this is O(findings × deviations) per chain. A HashMap<lint_id, Vec<Deviation>> indexed by target_lint would reduce the hot path to O(matching_deviations_for_lint) with O(1) lookup.
notes: Typical deviation store has < 20 entries. O(N) linear scan is fine. HashMap optimization adds complexity with no measurable benefit at this scale.
title: DeviationStore::find_deviation is O(N) linear scan; hot path for per-cert evaluation
